audit_focus: Disentangling Reflexion (external feedback / episodic memory) from Self-Refine (internal critique / training-free iterative refinement)

reflexion.feedback_source: External task feedback (unit test failure output, environment execution errors, scalar reward signals)
reflexion.memory_mechanism: Episodic memory buffer retaining linguistic self-reflections across consecutive trials
reflexion.key_results: Improves HumanEval pass@1 from 67.0% to 91.0% via test-feedback reflection loops

self_refine.feedback_source: Self-generated multi-aspect critique and actionable feedback without external tool or test execution
self_refine.memory_mechanism: Multi-turn dialogue context within a single iterative refinement session
self_refine.key_results: Improves one-step generation by ~20% absolute across 7 diverse generation tasks without training

conflation_in_wp006.flawed_statement: WP-006 claimed under Section 3.4 that 'Storing verbal self-reflections derived from execution failure signals in an episodic memory buffer enables agents to rapidly correct errors on subsequent attempts (Shinn et al. [Reflexion]; Madaan et al. [Self-Refine]).'
conflation_in_wp006.error_analysis: This attributed Reflexion's specific mechanisms (execution failure signals, episodic memory buffer) to Self-Refine. Self-Refine does NOT execute code, does NOT receive test failure signals, and does NOT use an episodic memory buffer across trials.

remediation.reflexion_source_fact: Reflexion endows language agents with verbal reinforcement learning by converting external environment feedback (e.g. test failures, scalar rewards) into natural language self-reflections stored in an episodic memory buffer across consecutive trials.
remediation.self_refine_source_fact: Self-Refine iteratively improves text generation using self-generated multi-aspect critique on a single frozen LLM without external execution feedback, training data, or human annotations.
remediation.legitimate_synthesis: Both architectures demonstrate that iterative refinement driven by natural language feedback improves task performance without fine-tuning; Reflexion grounds feedback in external execution signals, whereas Self-Refine grounds feedback in internal multi-aspect self-critique.
